decisions.rationale: Large vessel occlusion stroke (middle cerebral artery atherosclerosis) does not match any leaf label directly and public knowledge snippets do not provide a clear relation to the leaf labels.

Large middle cerebral artery territory embolic stroke is a subtype of cardioembolic stroke, which is supported by public knowledge snippets that describe embolic strokes as nonlacunar and potentially involving large vessels such as the middle cerebral artery.

option_relations.rationale: Pacemaker lead-associated thromboembolic stroke matches the leaf label exactly.
Large vessel occlusion stroke (middle cerebral artery atherosclerosis) does not match any leaf label directly.
Acute ischemic stroke (cardioembolic origin secondary to atrial fibrillation) matches cardioembolic stroke and atrial fibrillation-related embolic stroke.
Large middle cerebral artery territory embolic stroke is a subtype of cardioembolic stroke.
